slides.say: With Fiber, React can pause, abort, and restart rendering. That only works if rendering is pure.

slides.text: Data changes mid-render? React can restart without finishing the outdated render.
slides.say: If data changes in the middle of rendering a deep tree, React can restart rendering without wasting time to finish the outdated render.
If a render can be started, thrown away, and redone, a side effect in render could run several times for one screen update.

slides.text: Pure render = safe to stop at any time. Side effects go in handlers or Effects.
slides.say: Purity makes it safe to stop calculating at any time. Keep side effects in event handlers or Effects, which only run for committed renders.
